first_error.stage: Tabulate candidate matters from saved results
first_error.why: Its broad scan reached every qualifying matter, but the agreement-file-name filter it printed at [44]-[45] dropped one matter's differently named executed agreement, and the reading list was built without it.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [47] said the file-name filter drops documents named differently; the agent rebuilt the table in attempt 2 but read only agreements it had already picked.

other_errors.why: After the write review, an edit moved a qualifying matter whose agreement it had read at [56] (a first draft with adjustment terms) out of the confirmed set into a draft-only note.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review at [91] told the agent to demote any matter with only a draft; the edit did so.

divergence: All three runs fail, each on one or two matters out of fifteen and in different ways. All used store-wide text scans that reached every qualifying matter, then read a chosen subset of agreements. T0 never opened the matter whose only agreement is named as a first draft and excluded it on its file name, and added one extra matter; T1 read that draft and kept it in a draft tier (passed) but also kept two other draft-only matters (precision fail); T2 lost a differently named executed agreement to its own file-name filter and, following a review to demote drafts, moved the first-draft matter out of the confirmed set. Reviews flagged file-name filtering specifically in T2 and pushed draft demotion in T1 and T2; agent-declared tally and inventory steps did not recover the dropped matter.
